# `fnox tui`

- **Usage:** `fnox tui`

Interactive TUI dashboard for managing secrets

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- fnox examples:start -->

## Examples

Browse and copy values in the terminal. Dashboard edits are held in memory only; use set or remove to persist changes.

```sh
fnox tui
fnox --profile staging tui
```
